items.name: Crock-of-Gold Charm
items.lore: A single gold coin from a leprechaun's crock. It's always there when you check.

items.name: Iron-Cage Bracer
items.lore: Cold iron from a leprechaun cage. Fae folk flinch from it.

items.name: Cobbler's Ring
items.lore: Leprechauns are cobblers, really. This is a ring of shoe-leather and silver tacks.

items.name: Goborchend Horn Torc
items.lore: Twisted goat-horn, bound in bronze. The goborchend wear their horns as trophies; you wear theirs.

items.name: Bloodhorn's Altar-Stone
items.lore: A chip from a goborchend altar. Druid Mor cleansed it. It's still red.

items.name: Oisin's Druid-Cloak
items.lore: Green and brown and full of pockets.

items.name: Fomorian-Bone Bracer
items.lore: The goborchend are of the old Fomorian blood. Their bones are heavy and hard.

items.name: Fort-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: Given to whoever first broke into a goborchend fort.
